subcategory_text: Have one or more qualified reviewers (other than the author) review the human-readable code (source, configuration, IaC, build scripts) for security defects, adherence to coding standards, and clarity.
implementation_examples: Enforce peer review on every pull request that touches production code
Provide reviewers with a security-focused review checklist
Track review SLAs and report missed reviews
assessment_objectives: Determine whether code reviews are mandatory and performed by a qualified reviewer.
Determine whether review records are retained.
